entries.title: Genesis 4:1
segments: And Adam knew Eve his wife. And she conceived and bore Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 4:2
segments: And she bore again, his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 4:3
segments: And in the end of days, it happened, Cain brought to the LORD an offering of the fruit of the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 4:4
segments: And Abel also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat of it. And the LORD had respect to Abel and to his offering,

entries.title: Genesis 4:5
segments: but He did not have respect to Cain and to his offering. And Cain glowed with anger, and his face fell.

entries.title: Genesis 4:6
segments: And the LORD said to Cain, Why have you angrily glowed? And why did your face fall?

entries.title: Genesis 4:7
segments: If you do well, shall you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin crouches at the door; and its desire [is] for you, and you shall rule over it.

entries.title: Genesis 4:8
segments: And Cain talked with his brother Abel. And it happened when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:9
segments: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where [is] your brother Abel? And he said, I do not know. [Am] I my brother's keeper?

entries.title: Genesis 4:10
segments: And He said, What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries to Me from the ground.

entries.title: Genesis 4:11
segments: And now you [are] cursed more than the ground which opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.

entries.title: Genesis 4:12
segments: When you till the ground, it will not again give its strength to you. And you shall be a vagabond and a fugitive in the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 4:13
segments: And Cain said to the LORD, My punishment [is] greater than I can bear.

entries.title: Genesis 4:14
segments: Behold! You have driven me out from the face of the earth today, and I shall be hidden from Your face. And I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth, and it shall be [that] anyone who finds me shall kill me.

entries.title: Genesis 4:15
segments: And the LORD said to him, Therefore whoever kills Cain shall be avenged seven times. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain so that anyone who found him should not kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:16
segments: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and lived in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

entries.title: Genesis 4:17
segments: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

entries.title: Genesis 4:18
segments: And Irad was born to Enoch. And Irad fathered Mehujael. And Mehujael fathered Methusael. And Methusael fathered Lamech.

entries.title: Genesis 4:19
segments: And Lamech took two wives to himself. The name of the first one [was] Adah, and the name of the other [was] Zillah.

entries.title: Genesis 4:20
segments: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents, and with cattle.

entries.title: Genesis 4:21
segments: And his brother's name [was] Jubal; he was the father of all those playing the harp and the organ.

entries.title: Genesis 4:22
segments: And Zillah also bore Tubalcain, [the] hammerer of every engraving tool of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

entries.title: Genesis 4:23
segments: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice, wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have killed a man because of my wound, and a young man because of my hurt.

entries.title: Genesis 4:24
segments: For Cain is avenged seven times, and Lamech seventy-seven times.

entries.title: Genesis 4:25
segments: And Adam knew his wife again. And she bore a son, and called his name Seth. For she said, God has appointed me another seed instead of Abel, because Cain killed him.

entries.title: Genesis 4:26
segments: And there was also a son born to Seth, and he called his name Enos. Then men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
